pages.text: Cost: 120 biomass. Offer 4 Tissue Fiber, 2 Hive Vein, 2 Living Hive Tissue, 1 Blighted Wither Core. Each infected Wither drops one core.$(br2)Equip in the legs slot for +25 attack damage. All four add 100 to the opening hit before the infinite Strength multiplier.$(br2)Black currents travel between the knees and thighs.
